translations.idiomatic: In exposing hidden wrongs he was like a spirit; when he caught powerful evildoers who would not submit, he always punished them severely until they were utterly destroyed, and the regions under his rule were brought to order.

sentences.zh: 洪、福、廣、越為生立祠。

translations.literal: Living shrines were erected to him in Hong, Fu, Guang, and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Living shrines were erected to him in Hong, Fu, Guang, and Yue.

sentences.zh: 張問，字昌言，襄陽人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Wen, courtesy name Changyan, was a native of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wen, courtesy name Changyan, was a native of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 進士起家，通判大名府。

translations.literal: He entered office through the jinshi and served as vice-prefect of Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office through the jinshi and served as vice-prefect of Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 群牧地在魏，歲久冒入於民，有司按舊籍括之，地數易主，券不明，吏苟趣辦，持詔書奪人田，至毀室盧、發丘墓。

translations.literal: Pasture lands of the Horse Herds Office lay in Wei; over many years they had been encroached upon by commoners. The responsible office, following old registers, sought to reclaim them; the lands had changed hands many times and deeds were unclear; clerks hurried to finish the task, wielded the edict to seize people's fields, and even destroyed houses and opened tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture lands of the Horse Herds Office lay in Wei; over many years they had been encroached upon by commoners. The responsible office, following old registers, sought to reclaim them; the lands had changed hands many times and deeds were unclear; clerks hurried to finish the task, wielded the edict to seize people's fields, and even destroyed houses and opened tombs.

sentences.zh: 問至，則曰：「是豈朝廷意耶？

translations.literal: When Wen arrived, he said: "Can this be the intent of the court?
translations.idiomatic: When Wen arrived, he said, "Can this be the intent of the court?"

sentences.zh: 」其上以聞。

translations.literal: " He reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: He reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 仁宗諭大臣曰：「吏用心悉如問，何患赤子之不安也。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong told the chief ministers: "If all clerks applied themselves as Wen does, what need would there be to fear that the people would not be secure?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong told the chief ministers, "If all clerks applied themselves as Wen does, what need would there be to fear that the people would not be secure?"

sentences.zh: 」 立罷之。

translations.literal: " The measure was immediately halted.
translations.idiomatic: The measure was immediately halted.

sentences.zh: 擢提點河北刑獄。

translations.literal: He was promoted to judicial intendant for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to judicial intendant for Hebei.

sentences.zh: 大河決，議築小吳，問言：「曹村、小吳南北相直，而曹村當水衝，賴小吳堤薄，水溢北出，故南堤無患。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River broke its banks, there was discussion of building dikes at Xiao Wu. Wen said: "Caocun and Xiao Wu lie north and south in a straight line, and Caocun sits in the path of the current; relying on the thin dike at Xiao Wu, the water overflowed northward, so the southern dike had no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River broke its banks, there was discussion of building dikes at Xiao Wu. Wen said, "Caocun and Xiao Wu lie north and south in a straight line, and Caocun sits in the path of the current; relying on the thin dike at Xiao Wu, the water overflowed northward, so the southern dike had no trouble."

sentences.zh: 若築小吳，則左強而右傷，南岸且決，水並京畿為害，獨可於孫、陳兩埽間起堤以備之耳。

translations.literal: If Xiao Wu is built up, the left bank will grow strong while the right is harmed; the southern bank will break, and the water will together harm the capital region. It would be enough merely to raise dikes between the Sun and Chen embankments as a precaution.
translations.idiomatic: If Xiao Wu is built up, the left bank will grow strong while the right is harmed; the southern bank will break, and the water will together harm the capital region. It would be enough merely to raise dikes between the Sun and Chen embankments as a precaution."

sentences.zh: 」詔付水官議，久不決，小吳卒潰。

translations.literal: An edict ordered water officials to discuss it; for a long time no decision was reached, and Xiao Wu ultimately burst.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered water officials to discuss it; for a long time no decision was reached, and Xiao Wu ultimately burst.

sentences.zh: 徙江東、淮南轉運使，加直集賢院、戶部判官，復為河北轉運使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to transport commissioner for Jiangdong and Huainan, promoted to direct access to the Jixian Hall and vice-director of the Revenue Bureau, and again served as transport commissioner for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to transport commissioner for Jiangdong and Huainan, promoted to direct access to the Jixian Hall and vice-director of the Revenue Bureau, and again served as transport commissioner for Hebei.

sentences.zh: 所部地震，河再決，議者欲調京東民三十萬，自澶築堤抵乾寧。

translations.literal: Earthquakes struck his circuit, and the river broke its banks twice; advisers wished to mobilize three hundred thousand people from Jingdong to build dikes from Chan to Qianning.
translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes struck his circuit, and the river broke its banks twice; advisers wished to mobilize three hundred thousand people from Jingdong to build dikes from Chan to Qianning.

sentences.zh: 問言：「堤未能為益，災傷之餘，力役勞民，非計也。

translations.literal: Wen said: "The dikes would not necessarily bring benefit; after disaster and injury, forced labor would further burden the people—this is no good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Wen said, "The dikes would not necessarily bring benefit; after disaster and injury, forced labor would further burden the people—this is no good plan."

sentences.zh: 」神宗從之。

translations.literal: Shenzong followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 問十年不奏考課，詔特遷其官，入為度支副使，拜集賢殿修撰、河東轉運使。

translations.literal: Wen for ten years did not submit performance evaluations; an edict specially promoted his rank. He entered office as vice-director of the Revenue Bureau, was appointed Hanlin compiler of the Jixian Hall and transport commissioner for Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Wen for ten years did not submit performance evaluations; an edict specially promoted his rank. He entered office as vice-director of the Revenue Bureau, was appointed Hanlin compiler of the Jixian Hall and transport commissioner for Hedong.

sentences.zh: 坐誤軍須，貶知光化軍，未幾，復使河北。

translations.literal: For an error in military supplies he was demoted to prefect of Guanghua Army; before long he was again sent to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: For an error in military supplies he was demoted to prefect of Guanghua Army; before long he was again sent to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 諸葛公權之亂，郡縣株蔓，連逮至數百千人，問上疏申理，止誅首惡。

translations.literal: In the disorder of Zhuge Gongquan, prefectures and counties were implicated in chains, with several hundred or thousand people arrested in succession. Wen submitted a memorial to plead their case, and only the chief culprits were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the disorder of Zhuge Gongquan, prefectures and counties were implicated in chains, with several hundred or thousand people arrested in succession. Wen submitted a memorial to plead their case, and only the chief culprits were executed.

sentences.zh: 熙寧末，知滄州。

translations.literal: At the end of the Xining period he served as prefect of Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Xining period he served as prefect of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 自新法行，問獨不阿時好。

translations.literal: Once the new laws were implemented, Wen alone did not flatter the prevailing fashion.
translations.idiomatic: Once the new laws were implemented, Wen alone did not flatter the prevailing fashion.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，為帝言民苟免常平、助役之苦，反以得流亡為幸，語切直驚人。

translations.literal: In a year of famine he told the emperor that if the people could only escape the hardships of the Ever-Normal and labor-levy policies, they would instead count exile as good fortune; his words were blunt and startling.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he told the emperor that if the people could only escape the hardships of the Ever-Normal and labor-levy policies, they would instead count exile as good fortune; his words were blunt and startling.

sentences.zh: 元豐定官制，王安禮薦問可任六曹侍郎，帝以其好異論，不用。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng official system was fixed, Wang Anli recommended Wen as fit for vice-minister of one of the Six Boards; the emperor, because he favored dissenting views, did not appoint him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuanfeng official system was fixed, Wang Anli recommended Wen as fit for vice-minister of one of the Six Boards; the emperor, because he favored dissenting views, did not appoint him.

sentences.zh: 歷知河陽、潞州。

translations.literal: He successively served as prefect of Heyang and Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as prefect of Heyang and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，為秘書監、給事中，累官正議大夫，卒，年七十五。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanyou period he served as Supervisor of the Imperial Library and supervising censor, rose to Righteousness Grand Master, and died at age seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou period he served as Supervisor of the Imperial Library and supervising censor, rose to Righteousness Grand Master, and died at age seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 問處己廉潔、嘗仕鄜延幕府，與种世衡善，父喪，世衡遺汝州田十頃，辭弗受。

translations.literal: Wen was personally incorrupt; he had once served on the Fuyan military staff and was on good terms with Zhong Shiheng. When his father died, Shiheng offered him ten qing of land in Ruzhou, but he declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Wen was personally incorrupt; he had once served on the Fuyan military staff and was on good terms with Zhong Shiheng. When his father died, Shiheng offered him ten qing of land in Ruzhou, but he declined and would not accept.

sentences.zh: 使歸，未至而世衡卒。

translations.literal: When he was sent home, he had not yet arrived when Shiheng died.
translations.idiomatic: When he was sent home, he had not yet arrived when Shiheng died.

sentences.zh: 其子古，用父治命，亦不納田，蕪穢者三十年。

translations.literal: His son Gu, following his father's final instructions, also would not accept the land; it lay fallow for thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gu, following his father's final instructions, also would not accept the land; it lay fallow for thirty years.

sentences.zh: 後汝守請以給學，朝廷命反諸种氏。

translations.literal: Later the prefect of Ru asked that it be given to the school; the court ordered it returned to the Zhong clan.
translations.idiomatic: Later the prefect of Ru asked that it be given to the school; the court ordered it returned to the Zhong clan.

sentences.zh: 熙寧時，有陳舜俞、樂京、劉蒙，亦以役法廢黜。

translations.literal: In the Xining period, Chen Shunyu, Le Jing, and Liu Meng were also dismissed over the labor-levy law.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xining period, Chen Shunyu, Le Jing, and Liu Meng were also dismissed over the labor-levy law.

sentences.zh: 陳舜俞

translations.literal: Chen Shunyu
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shunyu

sentences.zh: 舜俞，字令舉，湖州烏程人。

translations.literal: Shunyu, courtesy name Lingju, was a native of Wucheng in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shunyu, courtesy name Lingju, was a native of Wucheng in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 博學強記。

translations.literal: He was broadly learned and had a powerful memory.
translations.idiomatic: He was broadly learned and had a powerful memory.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，又舉制科第一。

translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xining, as Outer Director of the Directorate of Agriculture he served as prefect of Shanyin County; an edict ordered that upon the arrival of his replacement he return to test for a palace post.

translations.idiomatic: Shunyu declined, saying, "Rank and stipend are name-bearing vessels for sharpening many scholars—they should be shown through utmost sincerity. How can one fix a date in advance, as though delivering a contract?"

sentences.zh: 」繳中書帖上之。

translations.idiomatic: He returned the Secretariat notice to the throne.

translations.literal: Knowledgeable elders warned the youth of their townships, never failing to speak of lending as a hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Knowledgeable elders warned the youth of their townships, never failing to speak of lending as a hardship.

sentences.zh: 祖宗著令，以財物相出舉，任從書契，官不為理。

translations.idiomatic: The founders established statutes allowing private lending of property by written contract, with officials not intervening.

sentences.zh: 其保全元元之意，深遠如此。

translations.literal: Their intent to preserve the common people was as far-reaching as this.
translations.idiomatic: Their intent to preserve the common people was as far-reaching as this.

sentences.zh: 今誘之以便利，督之以威刑，方之舊法，異矣。

translations.literal: Now the people are enticed by convenience and compelled by harsh penalties; compared with the old law, it is different.
translations.idiomatic: Now the people are enticed by convenience and compelled by harsh penalties; compared with the old law, it is different.

sentences.zh: 詔謂振民乏絕而抑兼並，然使十戶為甲，浮浪無根者毋得給俵，則乏絕者已不蒙其惠。

translations.idiomatic: The edict says it is to relieve the people's want and restrain annexation, yet if ten households form a group and rootless drifters may not receive loans, then those in want already do not receive its benefit.

sentences.zh: 此法終行，愈為兼並地爾！

translations.literal: When this law is fully enforced, it will only become ground for annexation all the more!
translations.idiomatic: When this law is fully enforced, it will only become ground for annexation all the more!

sentences.zh: 何以言之？

translations.literal: How do I say this?
translations.idiomatic: How do I say this?

sentences.zh: 天下之有常平，非能人人計口受餉，但權穀價貴賤之柄，使積貯者不得深藏以邀利爾。

translations.literal: The empire has Ever-Normal Granaries not so that every person can be rationed by mouth, but to hold the lever of grain prices high and low so that hoarders cannot hide grain deep to seek profit.
translations.idiomatic: The empire has Ever-Normal Granaries not so that every person can be rationed by mouth, but to hold the lever of grain prices high and low so that hoarders cannot hide grain deep to seek profit.

sentences.zh: 今散為青苗，唯恐不盡，萬一饑饉薦至，必有乘時貴糶者，未知將何法以制之？

translations.literal: Now it is dispersed as Green Sprouts loans, fearing only that it is not fully spent; should famine come in succession, there will surely be those who sell grain dear at the opportune moment—who knows by what law this will be restrained?
translations.idiomatic: Now it is dispersed as Green Sprouts loans, fearing only that it is not fully spent; should famine come in succession, there will surely be those who sell grain dear at the opportune moment—who knows by what law this will be restrained?

sentences.zh: 官制既放錢取息，富室藏鏹，坐待鄰里逋欠之時，田宅妻孥隨欲而得，是豈不為兼並利哉。

translations.literal: Since the official system now lends money for interest, the wealthy hide their cash and sit waiting for the time when neighbors default; then fields, houses, wives, and children may be taken at will—is this not profit for annexation?
translations.idiomatic: Since the official system now lends money for interest, the wealthy hide their cash and sit waiting for the time when neighbors default; then fields, houses, wives, and children may be taken at will—is this not profit for annexation?

sentences.zh: 雖分為夏秋二科，而秋放之月與夏斂之期等，夏放之月與秋斂之期等，不過展轉計息，以給為納，使吾民終身以及世世，每歲兩輸息錢，無有窮已。

translations.literal: Although divided into summer and autumn installments, the month of autumn disbursement equals the period of summer collection, and the month of summer disbursement equals the period of autumn collection—it is nothing but rolling over interest, using disbursement as collection, so that our people for life and for generation after generation pay interest twice each year without end.

sentences.zh: 是別為一賦以敝海內，非王道之舉也。

translations.literal: This is establishing a separate tax to exhaust the empire—not the conduct of true kingship.
translations.idiomatic: This is establishing a separate tax to exhaust the empire—not the conduct of true kingship.

sentences.zh: 」奏上，責監南康軍鹽酒稅，五年而卒。

translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, he was assigned to supervise the salt and wine tax at Nankang Army; five years later he died.

sentences.zh: 舜俞始嘗棄官歸，居秀之白牛村，自號「白牛居士」。

translations.literal: Shunyu had once resigned office and returned home, living at Bainiu Village in Xiu and styling himself "Layman of the White Ox."
translations.idiomatic: Shunyu had once resigned office and returned home, living at Bainiu Village in Xiu and styling himself "Layman of the White Ox."

sentences.zh: 已而復出，遂貶死。

translations.literal: Later he came out again and was ultimately demoted to death.
translations.idiomatic: Later he came out again and was ultimately demoted to death.

sentences.zh: 蘇軾為文哭之，稱其學術才能，「兼百人之器……慨然將以身任天下之事……而人之所以周旋委曲、輔成其天者不至」，一斥不復，士大夫識與不識，皆深悲之云。

translations.literal: Su Shi wrote a mourning piece for him, praising his learning and talent: "He combined the capacities of a hundred men; he resolved in all seriousness to take upon himself the affairs of the empire; yet those who should have maneuvered tactfully and helped fulfill his natural gifts did not come to his side." Once dismissed, he was never restored; whether scholars knew him or not, all deeply mourned him, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi wrote a funeral elegy praising his scholarship and ability: "He united in himself the talents of a hundred men; he resolved to shoulder the affairs of the empire; yet those who should have worked tactfully at his side to bring his gifts to fulfillment never appeared." After a single dismissal he was never recalled; whether they knew him or not, all among the scholar-official class grieved deeply for him.

sentences.zh: 京，荊南人。

translations.literal: Le Jing was a man of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Le Jing was a man of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 為布衣時，鄉里稱其行義，事母至孝。

translations.literal: While still a commoner, his village praised his conduct and righteousness; in serving his mother he was supremely filial.
translations.idiomatic: While still a commoner, his village praised his conduct and righteousness; in serving his mother he was supremely filial.

sentences.zh: 妻張氏家絕，挾女弟自隨，京未嘗見其面。

translations.literal: His wife's Zhang clan had no relatives left; she brought her younger sister with her, and Jing never once saw her face.
translations.idiomatic: His wife's Zhang clan had no relatives left; she brought her younger sister with her, and Jing never once saw her face.

sentences.zh: 妻死，京寢食於外，為嫁之。

translations.literal: When his wife died, Jing slept and ate outside and arranged a marriage for the younger sister.
translations.idiomatic: When his wife died, Jing slept and ate outside and arranged a marriage for the younger sister.

sentences.zh: 神宗求言，京上疏以畏天保民為請。

translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong sought opinions, Jing submitted a memorial requesting reverence for Heaven and protection of the people.

sentences.zh: 知長葛縣。

translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Changge County.

translations.idiomatic: The intendant impeached him, and an edict stripped him of his post as Assistant Editor.

translations.idiomatic: After ten years his office was restored; he supervised the wine tax at Huangzhou and retired as Master of Discussion.

translations.idiomatic: Liu Meng, courtesy name Ziming, was a man of Bohai.

translations.idiomatic: Ashamed to compose regulated verse, he refused to take the jinshi;

translations.idiomatic: he studied for the "Outstanding Talent, Exceptional Grade" examination, yet also did not wish to sell himself.

translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan transport commissioner Liu Xiang recommended him as a recluse of talent; summoned for examination he ranked first and served as magistrate of Huyang County.

translations.idiomatic: He returned home to teach, supporting his parents and lecturing; many followed him in study.

translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfeng he died at only forty.

translations.idiomatic: Students and friends composed elegies for his conduct and styled him "Master Righteous Thought."

translations.literal: Miao Shizhong
translations.idiomatic: Miao Shizhong

translations.idiomatic: Miao Shizhong, courtesy name Ziju, was descended from ancestors who moved from Huguan to Suzhou.

translations.idiomatic: Through yin privilege he served as recorder of Ningling.

translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to judicial adjutant of Luzhou.

translations.idiomatic: The prefect wished to put one prisoner to death; Shizhong firmly refused.

translations.idiomatic: In the Xining period, as Director of the Directorate of Agriculture he was sent to the Zizhou circuit and secretly recommended ten capable officials; all were later promoted, yet people ultimately never knew of it.

translations.idiomatic: When the Jiaozhi people violated the border, he was promoted to vice transport commissioner for Guangxi.

translations.idiomatic: The army punished the Jiaozhi for their crimes and halted at the Fu Liang River, not advancing for a long time.

translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice transport commissioner for Zizhou.

translations.idiomatic: Cunbao would not listen and ultimately was executed for it.

translations.literal: Lin Guang replaced Cunbao.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Guang replaced Cunbao.

translations.idiomatic: Qidi had already submitted but fled again; officers and soldiers looked at one another and turned pale.

translations.idiomatic: At evening the watch drums did not sound; Shizhong asked Guang, and Guang said, "Since we lost the bandit, I therefore released the troops to pursue him and had no time to attend to that."

translations.idiomatic: Shizhong said, "The Son of Heaven entrusted you with a hundred thousand men—can courage consist in a single death alone?"

translations.idiomatic: Now we enter foreign territory; disaster may come and cannot be foreseen.

translations.idiomatic: Guang understood, immediately halted the pursuers, and marched the army forward in order.

translations.idiomatic: Han Zhi, courtesy name Xianchen, was a native of Changshan in Qizhou.

translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi and reached Palace Attendant Censor.

translations.idiomatic: For a minor offense he was dismissed to supervise the Jiangzhou tax.

translations.idiomatic: When Jinghu and Hunan suffered disaster, he went out bearing the staff as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 湘中自馬氏擅國，計丁輸米，身死產竭不得免，贄奏除之。

translations.literal: In Xiangzhong, since the Ma clan monopolized the state, rice was levied by head count; even when a person died and property was exhausted one could not be exempted. Zhi memorialized to abolish this.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangzhong, since the Ma clan monopolized the state, rice was levied by head count; even when a person died and property was exhausted one could not be exempted. Zhi memorialized to abolish this.

sentences.zh: 改知諫院，進天章閣待制。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Remonstrance Bureau and promoted to Hanlin attendant of the Tianzhang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Remonstrance Bureau and promoted to Hanlin attendant of the Tianzhang Hall.

sentences.zh: 宰相梁適以私容奸，狄青起卒伍、位樞密，內侍王守忠遷官不次，皆舉劾無所諱。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Liang Shi privately shielded wrongdoers; Di Qing rose from the ranks to the Bureau of Military Affairs; inner attendant Wang Shouzhong was promoted out of turn—all were impeached without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Liang Shi privately shielded wrongdoers; Di Qing rose from the ranks to the Bureau of Military Affairs; inner attendant Wang Shouzhong was promoted out of turn—all were impeached without reserve.

sentences.zh: 出知滄、瀛二州，遷龍圖閣直學士、河北都轉運使。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Cang and Ying, was transferred to Hanlin associate academician of the Longtu Hall and metropolitan transport commissioner for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to serve as prefect of Cang and Ying, was transferred to Hanlin associate academician of the Longtu Hall and metropolitan transport commissioner for Hebei.

sentences.zh: 河決商胡而北，議者欲復之。

translations.literal: The river broke north at Shanghu; advisers wished to restore the old course.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke north at Shanghu; advisers wished to restore the old course.

sentences.zh: 役將興，贄言：「北流既安定，驟更之，未必能成功。

translations.literal: Labor was about to begin when Zhi said: "The northern flow has already stabilized; if it is suddenly changed, success may not necessarily be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Labor was about to begin when Zhi said, "The northern flow has already stabilized; if it is suddenly changed, success may not necessarily be achieved."

sentences.zh: 不若開魏金堤使分注故道，支為兩河，或可紓水患。

translations.literal: It would be better to open the Wei Jin dike so that water divides into the old channel, branching into two rivers—perhaps water disasters could be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to open the Wei Jin dike so that water divides into the old channel, branching into two rivers—perhaps water disasters could be relieved."

sentences.zh: 」詔遣使相視，如其策，才役三千人，幾月而畢。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to inspect together; following his plan, only three thousand laborers were used, and it was finished in several months.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched envoys to inspect together; following his plan, only three thousand laborers were used, and it was finished in several months.

sentences.zh: 入判都水監，權開封府，政簡而治。

translations.literal: He entered office as director of the Directorate of Waterways, acting prefect of Kaifeng; his government was simple and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office as director of the Directorate of Waterways, acting prefect of Kaifeng; his government was simple and orderly.

sentences.zh: 知河南府，建永厚陵，費省而不擾，神宗稱之。

translations.literal: As prefect of Henan he built the Yonghou Mausoleum, saving expense without disturbing the people; Shenzong praised him.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Henan he built the Yonghou Mausoleum, saving expense without disturbing the people; Shenzong praised him.

sentences.zh: 還知審刑院、糾察在京刑獄，知徐州，以吏部侍郎致仕。

translations.literal: He returned to direct the Court of Judicial Review and inspect capital punishments, served as prefect of Xuzhou, and retired as Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to direct the Court of Judicial Review and inspect capital punishments, served as prefect of Xuzhou, and retired as Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 贄性行淑均，平居自奉至約，推所得祿賜買田贍族黨，賴以活者殆百數。

translations.literal: Zhi's nature and conduct were gentle and even; in ordinary life he was extremely sparing with himself; he used his salary and gifts to buy fields to support his clan, and those who relied on him for survival numbered nearly a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi's nature and conduct were gentle and even; in ordinary life he was extremely sparing with himself; he used his salary and gifts to buy fields to support his clan, and those who relied on him for survival numbered nearly a hundred.

sentences.zh: 退休十五年，謝絕人事，讀書賦詩以自娛。

translations.literal: For fifteen years in retirement he declined worldly affairs, reading books and composing poetry for his own pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: For fifteen years in retirement he declined worldly affairs, reading books and composing poetry for his own pleasure.

sentences.zh: 年八十五，卒。

translations.literal: He died at age eighty-five.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age eighty-five.

sentences.zh: 楚建中

translations.literal: Chu Jianzhong
translations.idiomatic: Chu Jianzhong

sentences.zh: 楚建中，字正叔，洛陽人。

translations.literal: Chu Jianzhong, courtesy name Zhengshu, was a native of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Jianzhong, courtesy name Zhengshu, was a native of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 第進士，知滎河縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi and served as magistrate of Xinghe County.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi and served as magistrate of Xinghe County.

sentences.zh: 民苦鹽稅不平，建中約田多寡以為輕重。

translations.literal: The people suffered from unequal salt taxes; Jianzhong assessed fields by amount to determine light and heavy levies.
translations.idiomatic: The people suffered from unequal salt taxes; Jianzhong assessed fields by amount to determine light and heavy levies.

sentences.zh: 主管鄜延經略機宜文字。

translations.literal: He supervised strategic planning documents for the Fuyan frontier commission.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised strategic planning documents for the Fuyan frontier commission.

sentences.zh: 夏人來正土疆，往蒞其事。

translations.literal: When the Tangut people came to fix the border, he went to preside over the matter.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tangut people came to fix the border, he went to preside over the matter.

sentences.zh: 眾暴至，兩騎傅矢引滿向之，建中披腹使射，曰：「吾不憚死。

translations.literal: A crowd suddenly arrived; two horsemen fitted arrows and drew their bows full toward him. Jianzhong bared his belly and had them shoot, saying: "I do not fear death.
translations.idiomatic: A crowd suddenly arrived; two horsemen fitted arrows and drew their bows full toward him. Jianzhong bared his belly and had them shoot, saying, "I do not fear death."

sentences.zh: 」騎即去，眾服其量。

translations.literal: " The horsemen immediately departed; the crowd admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: The horsemen immediately departed; the crowd admired his magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 元昊歸款，建中白府請築安定、黑水八堡以控東道，夏人果來，聞有備，不敢入。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao submitted, Jianzhong reported to the commission requesting construction of the eight forts of Anding and Heishui to control the eastern route; the Tangut people indeed came, heard there were preparations, and did not dare enter.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao submitted, Jianzhong reported to the commission requesting construction of the eight forts of Anding and Heishui to control the eastern route; the Tangut people indeed came, heard there were preparations, and did not dare enter.

sentences.zh: 累遷提點京東刑獄、鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to judicial intendant for Jingdong, and salt and iron vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to judicial intendant for Jingdong, and salt and iron vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 昭陵建，命裁定調度，省數十萬計。

translations.literal: When the Zhaoling Mausoleum was built, he was ordered to fix allocations and planning, saving several hundred thousand in costs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhaoling Mausoleum was built, he was ordered to fix allocations and planning, saving several hundred thousand in costs.

sentences.zh: 歷夔路、淮南、京西轉運使，進度支副使。

translations.literal: He served as transport commissioner for Kuizhou, Huainan, and Jingxi, and was promoted to vice-director of the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He served as transport commissioner for Kuizhou, Huainan, and Jingxi, and was promoted to vice-director of the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 神宗用事西鄙，以建中嘗為邊臣所薦，召欲用之，言不合旨，出知滄州。

translations.literal: Shenzong was active on the western frontier; because Jianzhong had once been recommended by a frontier official, he was summoned with intent to employ him; his words did not accord with the imperial intent, and he was sent out as prefect of Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong was active on the western frontier; because Jianzhong had once been recommended by a frontier official, he was summoned with intent to employ him; his words did not accord with the imperial intent, and he was sent out as prefect of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，為天章閣待制、陝西都轉運使，知慶州、江寧、成德軍，以正議大夫致仕。

translations.literal: After a long time he served as Hanlin attendant of the Tianzhang Hall and metropolitan transport commissioner for Shaanxi, prefect of Qingzhou, Jiangning, and Chengde Army, and retired as Righteousness Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he served as Hanlin attendant of the Tianzhang Hall and metropolitan transport commissioner for Shaanxi, prefect of Qingzhou, Jiangning, and Chengde Army, and retired as Righteousness Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，文彥博薦為戶部侍郎，不拜。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Wen Yanbo recommended him as Vice Minister of Revenue, but he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Wen Yanbo recommended him as Vice Minister of Revenue, but he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died at age eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 張頡，字仲舉，其先金陵人，徙鼎州桃源。

translations.literal: Zhang Jie, courtesy name Zhongju, was descended from ancestors of Jinling who moved to Taoyuan in Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jie, courtesy name Zhongju, was descended from ancestors of Jinling who moved to Taoyuan in Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 第進士，調江陵推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi and was appointed judicial reviewer of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi and was appointed judicial reviewer of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 歲旱饑，朝廷遣使安撫，頡條獻十事，活數萬人。

translations.literal: In a year of drought and famine, the court dispatched envoys for relief; Jie submitted ten items in detail and saved tens of thousands of lives.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of drought and famine, the court dispatched envoys for relief; Jie submitted ten items in detail and saved tens of thousands of lives.

sentences.zh: 知益陽縣，縣接梅山溪峒，多蠻獠出沒，頡按禁地約束，召徭人耕墾，上其事，不報。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Yiyang County, the county adjoined the Meishan streams and caves where many Man and Liao came and went; Jie enforced restrictions on forbidden lands, summoned the yao people to reclaim and cultivate, and reported upward—but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Yiyang County, the county adjoined the Meishan streams and caves where many Man and Liao came and went; Jie enforced restrictions on forbidden lands, summoned the yao people to reclaim and cultivate, and reported upward—but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 累遷開封府判官、提點江西刑獄、廣東轉運使。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Kaifeng vice-prefect, judicial intendant for Jiangxi, and transport commissioner for Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Kaifeng vice-prefect, judicial intendant for Jiangxi, and transport commissioner for Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，章惇取南江地，建沅、懿等州，克梅山，與楊光僭為敵。

translations.literal: In the Xining period, Zhang Dun seized the Nanjiang lands, established Yuan, Yi, and other prefectures, conquered Meishan, and became enemies with Yang Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xining period, Zhang Dun seized the Nanjiang lands, established Yuan, Yi, and other prefectures, conquered Meishan, and became enemies with Yang Guang.

sentences.zh: 頡居憂於鼎，移書朝貴，言南江殺戮過甚，無辜者十八九，浮屍蔽江，民不食魚者數月。

translations.literal: Jie was in mourning at Ding and wrote to court nobles, saying the slaughter in Nanjiang was excessive—eight or nine out of ten were innocent; floating corpses covered the river, and for months the people would not eat fish.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was in mourning at Ding and wrote to court nobles, saying the slaughter in Nanjiang was excessive—eight or nine out of ten were innocent; floating corpses covered the river, and for months the people would not eat fish.

sentences.zh: 惇疾其說，欲分功啖之。

translations.literal: Dun resented his argument and wished to share credit to buy him off.
translations.idiomatic: Dun resented his argument and wished to share credit to buy him off.

sentences.zh: 乃言曰：「頡昔令益陽，首建梅山之議，今日成功，權輿於頡。

translations.literal: He therefore said: "Jie once served as magistrate of Yiyang and first proposed the Meishan plan; today's success originated with Jie.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore said, "Jie once served as magistrate of Yiyang and first proposed the Meishan plan; today's success originated with Jie."

sentences.zh: 」詔賜絹三百匹。

translations.literal: An edict granted three hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted three hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 尋擢江淮制置發運副使，改知荊南，復徙廣西轉運使。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to vice commissioner for Jiang-Huai grain dispatch and military provisioning, transferred to prefect of Jingnan, and again moved to transport commissioner for Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to vice commissioner for Jiang-Huai grain dispatch and military provisioning, transferred to prefect of Jingnan, and again moved to transport commissioner for Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 時建廣源為順州，將城之，頡謂無益，朝廷從其議。

translations.literal: At the time Guangyuan was being established as Shun Prefecture and was about to be walled; Jie said it would be of no benefit, and the court followed his view.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Guangyuan was being established as Shun Prefecture and was about to be walled; Jie said it would be of no benefit, and the court followed his view.

sentences.zh: 坐捽罵參軍沈竦罷歸。

translations.literal: For beating and reviling the adjutant Shen Song he was dismissed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: For beating and reviling the adjutant Shen Song he was dismissed and returned home.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以直集賢院知齊、滄二州，進直龍圖閣、知桂州。

translations.literal: Before long, with direct access to the Jixian Hall he served as prefect of Qi and Cang, was promoted to direct access to the Longtu Hall and prefect of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, with direct access to the Jixian Hall he served as prefect of Qi and Cang, was promoted to direct access to the Longtu Hall and prefect of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 入覲，帝首言：「卿向者論順州不可守，信然。

translations.literal: On entering audience, the emperor first said: "You formerly argued that Shun Prefecture could not be held—and so it proved.
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience, the emperor first said, "You formerly argued that Shun Prefecture could not be held—and so it proved."

sentences.zh: 」時有獻言者謂：「海南黎人陳被蓋五洞酋領，異時盛強，且為中國患。

translations.literal: At the time a memorializer said: "Chen Bei of the Hainan Li, chieftain of the five caves, was once powerful and would become a trouble to China; now he asks to send troops to prove his loyalty—it is fitting that he be placated and received.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a memorializer said, "Chen Bei of the Hainan Li, chieftain of the five caves, was once powerful and would become a trouble to China; now he asks to send troops to prove his loyalty—it is fitting that he be placated and received."

sentences.zh: 今請出兵自效，宜有以撫納之。
」命頡處其事。

translations.literal: Jie was ordered to handle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was ordered to handle the matter.

sentences.zh: 頡使一介往呼之出，補以牙校，喜而去。

translations.literal: Jie sent one messenger to summon him out, appointed him a petty military officer, and he departed pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Jie sent one messenger to summon him out, appointed him a petty military officer, and he departed pleased.

sentences.zh: 詔問何賞之薄，對曰：「荒徼蠻蜒無他覬，得是足矣。

translations.literal: An edict asked why the reward was so meager; he replied: "In the wild frontier the barbarian serpents have no other designs—this is enough.
translations.idiomatic: An edict asked why the reward was so meager; he replied, "In the wild frontier the barbarian serpents have no other designs—this is enough."

sentences.zh: 」尋罷兵，海外訖無事。

translations.literal: Soon troops were withdrawn, and beyond the seas there was peace to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Soon troops were withdrawn, and beyond the seas there was peace to the end.

sentences.zh: 久之，轉運使馬默劾其經理宜州蠻事失宜，罷職知均州。

translations.literal: After a long time, Transport Commissioner Ma Mo impeached him for mishandling the Man affairs at Yizhou; he was dismissed and served as prefect of Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, Transport Commissioner Ma Mo impeached him for mishandling the Man affairs at Yizhou; he was dismissed and served as prefect of Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 哲宗立，還故職，知鳳翔、廣州，召為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Zhezong ascended, he was restored to his former post, served as prefect of Fengxiang and Guangzhou, and was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhezong ascended, he was restored to his former post, served as prefect of Fengxiang and Guangzhou, and was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 頡所歷以嚴致理，而深文狡獪。

translations.literal: In every post Jie governed through severity; yet he was deep in legalistic cunning.
translations.idiomatic: In every post Jie governed through severity; yet he was deep in legalistic cunning.

sentences.zh: 右司諫蘇轍論其九罪，執政以頡雖無德而才可用，不報。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Officer Su Zhe enumerated nine crimes against him; the chief ministers held that although Jie lacked virtue he was talented and usable, and no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Officer Su Zhe enumerated nine crimes against him; the chief ministers held that although Jie lacked virtue he was talented and usable, and no reply was given.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以寶文閣待制出為河北都轉運使，徙知瀛州。

translations.literal: After a year, as Hanlin attendant of the Baowen Hall he went out as metropolitan transport commissioner for Hebei and was transferred to prefect of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a year, as Hanlin attendant of the Baowen Hall he went out as metropolitan transport commissioner for Hebei and was transferred to prefect of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 湖北溪徭叛，朝廷託頡素望，復徙知荊南，至都門，暴卒。

translations.literal: When the stream Yao of Hubei rebelled, the court, relying on Jie's longstanding reputation, again transferred him to prefect of Jingnan; upon reaching the capital gate he suddenly died.
translations.idiomatic: When the stream Yao of Hubei rebelled, the court, relying on Jie's longstanding reputation, again transferred him to prefect of Jingnan; upon reaching the capital gate he suddenly died.

sentences.zh: 盧革，字仲辛，湖州德清人。

translations.literal: Lu Ge, courtesy name Zhongxin, was a native of Deqing in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Ge, courtesy name Zhongxin, was a native of Deqing in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 少舉童子，知杭州馬亮見所為詩，嗟異之。

translations.literal: In youth he passed the child scholar examination; Ma Liang, prefect of Hangzhou, saw poems he had written and marveled at them.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he passed the child scholar examination; Ma Liang, prefect of Hangzhou, saw poems he had written and marveled at them.

sentences.zh: 秋，貢士，密戒主司勿遺革。

translations.literal: That autumn, when presenting scholars, he secretly warned the chief examiner not to omit Ge.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, when presenting scholars, he secretly warned the chief examiner not to omit Ge.

sentences.zh: 革聞，語人曰：「以私得薦，吾恥之。

translations.literal: Ge heard of it and told others: "To gain recommendation through private favor—I am ashamed of that.
translations.idiomatic: Ge heard of it and told others, "To gain recommendation through private favor—I am ashamed of that."

sentences.zh: 」去弗就。

translations.literal: " He departed and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: He departed and did not go.

sentences.zh: 後二年，遂首選；

translations.literal: Two years later he ranked first;
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he ranked first;

sentences.zh: 至登第，年才十六。

translations.literal: when he passed the jinshi he was only sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: when he passed the jinshi he was only sixteen.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，知龔州。

translations.literal: In the Qingli period he served as prefect of Gong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qingli period he served as prefect of Gong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蠻入寇，桂管騷動，革經畫軍須，先事而集。

translations.literal: When the Man raided, the Guiguan region was disturbed; Ge planned military supplies and gathered them beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: When the Man raided, the Guiguan region was disturbed; Ge planned military supplies and gathered them beforehand.

sentences.zh: 移書安撫使杜杞，請治諸郡城，及易長吏之不才者。

translations.literal: He wrote to the pacification commissioner Du Qi requesting that city walls of the various prefectures be repaired and that incompetent chief officials be replaced.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to the pacification commissioner Du Qi requesting that city walls of the various prefectures be repaired and that incompetent chief officials be replaced.

sentences.zh: 又言：「嶺外小郡，合四五不當中州一大縣，無城池甲兵之備，將為賊困，宜度遠近並省之。

translations.literal: He also said: "The small prefectures beyond the ridges—four or five together do not equal one large county of the central provinces; they have no city walls or armor and weapons for defense, and will be trapped by bandits—it is fitting to assess distance and combine and reduce them.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The small prefectures beyond the ridges—four or five together do not equal one large county of the central provinces; they have no city walls or armor and weapons for defense, and will be trapped by bandits—it is fitting to assess distance and combine and reduce them."

sentences.zh: 」後儂智高來，九郡相繼不守，皆如革慮。

translations.literal: Later when Nong Zhigao came, nine prefectures in succession could not be held—all as Ge had foreseen.
translations.idiomatic: Later when Nong Zhigao came, nine prefectures in succession could not be held—all as Ge had foreseen.

sentences.zh: 知婺、泉二州，提點廣東刑獄、福建湖南轉運使。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Wu and Quan, judicial intendant for Guangdong, and transport commissioner for Fujian and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Wu and Quan, judicial intendant for Guangdong, and transport commissioner for Fujian and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 復請外，神宗謂宰相曰：「革廉退如是，宜與嘉郡。

translations.literal: He again requested an outside post; Shenzong told the chief councillor: "Ge is so incorrupt and retiring—it is fitting to give him a fine prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again requested an outside post; Shenzong told the chief councillor, "Ge is so incorrupt and retiring—it is fitting to give him a fine prefecture."

sentences.zh: 」遂為宣州。

translations.literal: He was therefore appointed to Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore appointed to Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以光祿卿致仕。

translations.literal: He retired as Director of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He retired as Director of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 用子秉恩轉通議大夫，退居於吳十五年。

translations.literal: Through his son Bing's grace he was transferred to Master of Discussion; he withdrew to live in Wu for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Through his son Bing's grace he was transferred to Master of Discussion; he withdrew to live in Wu for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 秉為發運使，得請歲一歸覲。

translations.literal: Bing served as grain-dispatch commissioner and obtained permission to return once a year to visit his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Bing served as grain-dispatch commissioner and obtained permission to return once a year to visit his parents.

sentences.zh: 後帥渭，乞解官終養。

translations.literal: Later as commander of Wei he begged to resign office and end his life in filial service.
translations.idiomatic: Later as commander of Wei he begged to resign office and end his life in filial service.

sentences.zh: 帝數賜詔慰勉，時以為榮。

translations.literal: The emperor repeatedly sent edicts to comfort and encourage him; at the time this was considered an honor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly sent editions to comfort and encourage him; at the time this was considered an honor.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十二。

translations.literal: He died at age eighty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age eighty-two.

sentences.zh: 子 秉

translations.literal: His son Bing
translations.idiomatic: His son Bing

sentences.zh: 秉，字仲甫，未冠，有雋譽。

translations.literal: Bing, courtesy name Zhongfu, before reaching adulthood already had a reputation for excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Bing, courtesy name Zhongfu, before reaching adulthood already had a reputation for excellence.

sentences.zh: 嘗謁蔣堂，坐池亭，堂曰：「亭沼粗適，恨林木未就爾。

translations.literal: He once visited Jiang Tang and sat in the pool pavilion; Tang said: "The pavilion and pool are roughly suitable—I regret only that the trees and forest are not yet complete.
translations.idiomatic: He once visited Jiang Tang and sat in the pool pavilion; Tang said, "The pavilion and pool are roughly suitable—I regret only that the trees and forest are not yet complete."

sentences.zh: 」秉曰：「亭沼如爵位，時來或有之；

translations.literal: Bing said: "Pavilions and pools are like rank and office—when the time comes one may sometimes have them;
translations.idiomatic: Bing said, "Pavilions and pools are like rank and office—when the time comes one may sometimes have them;

sentences.zh: 林木非培植根株弗成，大似士大夫立名節也。

translations.literal: trees and forests are not achieved without cultivating roots and stems—it greatly resembles a scholar-official establishing name and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: trees and forests are not achieved without cultivating roots and stems—it greatly resembles a scholar-official establishing name and integrity.

sentences.zh: 」堂賞味其言，曰：「吾子必為佳器。」

translations.literal: Tang savored his words and said: "My young friend will surely become an outstanding vessel."
translations.idiomatic: Tang savored his words and said, "My young friend will surely become an outstanding vessel."

sentences.zh: 中進士甲科，調吉州推官、青州掌書記、知開封府倉曹參軍，浮湛州縣二十年，人無知者。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the first rank, was appointed judicial reviewer of Jizhou, secretary of Qingzhou, and warehouse adjutant of Kaifeng Prefecture; he drifted through prefectures and counties for twenty years, and no one knew him.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the first rank, was appointed judicial reviewer of Jizhou, secretary of Qingzhou, and warehouse adjutant of Kaifeng Prefecture; he drifted through prefectures and counties for twenty years, and no one knew him.

sentences.zh: 王安石得其壁間詩，識其靜退，方置條例司，預選中。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi saw poems he had written on the wall, recognized his quiet retirement, and when establishing the Regulations Office selected him among those chosen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi saw poems he had written on the wall, recognized his quiet retirement, and when establishing the Regulations Office selected him among those chosen.

sentences.zh: 奉使淮、浙治鹽法，與薛向究索利病，出本錢業鬻海之民，戒不得私鬻，還奏，遂為定制。

translations.literal: Sent as envoy to Huai and Zhe to administer the salt law, together with Xue Xiang he investigated profits and losses, advanced capital to establish the sea-salt trade among the people, forbade private sale, returned and memorialized, and it became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Sent as envoy to Huai and Zhe to administer the salt law, together with Xue Xiang he investigated profits and losses, advanced capital to establish the sea-salt trade among the people, forbade private sale, returned and memorialized, and it became fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 檢正吏房公事，提點兩浙、淮東刑獄，專提舉鹽事，持法苛嚴，追胥連保，罪及妻孥，一歲中犯者以千萬數。

translations.literal: As rectifier of the Clerks Office, judicial intendant for the two Zhe and Huaidong circuits, and commissioner exclusively for salt affairs, he enforced the law harshly; pursuing collectors through joint guarantee, guilt reached wives and children—in one year offenders numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: As rectifier of the Clerks Office, judicial intendant for the two Zhe and Huaidong circuits, and commissioner exclusively for salt affairs, he enforced the law harshly; pursuing collectors through joint guarantee, guilt reached wives and children—in one year offenders numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 進制置發運副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commissioner for grain dispatch and military provisioning.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commissioner for grain dispatch and military provisioning.

sentences.zh: 東南饑，詔損上供米價以糴。

translations.literal: When the southeast suffered famine, an edict reduced the price of tribute rice for purchase.
translations.idiomatic: When the southeast suffered famine, an edict reduced the price of tribute rice for purchase.

sentences.zh: 秉言：「價雖賤，貧者終艱得錢，請但償糴本，而以其餘振贍。

translations.literal: Bing said: "Although the price is low, the poor still find cash hard to obtain—please only repay the purchase principal and use the remainder for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Bing said, "Although the price is low, the poor still find cash hard to obtain—please only repay the purchase principal and use the remainder for relief."

sentences.zh: 」是歲上計，神宗問曰：「聞滁、和民捕蝗充食，有諸？

translations.literal: That year at the annual accounting, Shenzong asked: "I hear the people of Chu and He caught locusts to eat—is this so?
translations.idiomatic: That year at the annual accounting, Shenzong asked, "I hear the people of Chu and He caught locusts to eat—is this so?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「有之，民饑甚，殍死相枕籍。

translations.literal: He replied: "It is so—the people were extremely famished, and corpses of the starved lay pillow to pillow.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "It is so—the people were extremely famished, and corpses of the starved lay pillow to pillow."

sentences.zh: 」帝惻然曰：「前此獨趙抃為朕言之耳。

translations.literal: The emperor, moved, said: "Before this, only Zhao Bian told me of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, moved, said, "Before this, only Zhao Bian told me of it."

sentences.zh: 」先是，發運使多獻餘羨以希恩寵，秉言：「職在董督六路財賦，以時上之，安得羨。

translations.literal: Earlier, grain-dispatch commissioners often presented surpluses to seek imperial favor; Bing said: "The duty is to supervise the six circuits' finances and deliver them on time—how can there be surplus?
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, grain-dispatch commissioners often presented surpluses to seek imperial favor; Bing said, "The duty is to supervise the six circuits' finances and deliver them on time—how can there be surplus?"

sentences.zh: 今稱羨者，率正數也。

translations.literal: What is now called surplus is generally the regular quota.
translations.idiomatic: What is now called surplus is generally the regular quota.

sentences.zh: 請自是罷獻，獨以七十萬緡償三司逋。」

translations.literal: Please from now on cease presenting surpluses; only use seven hundred thousand strings of cash to repay the Three Departments' arrears."
translations.idiomatic: Please from now on cease presenting surpluses; only use seven hundred thousand strings of cash to repay the Three Departments' arrears."

sentences.zh: 加集賢殿修撰、知渭州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Hanlin compiler of the Jixian Hall and prefect of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hanlin compiler of the Jixian Hall and prefect of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 五路大出西討，唯涇原有功，進寶文閣待制。

translations.literal: The five circuits launched a great western campaign; only Jingyuan achieved merit, and he was promoted to Hanlin attendant of the Baowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The five circuits launched a great western campaign; only Jingyuan achieved merit, and he was promoted to Hanlin attendant of the Baowen Hall.

sentences.zh: 夏境胡盧川距塞二百里，恃險遠不設備，秉遣將姚麟、彭孫襲擊之，俘斬萬計。

translations.literal: The Tangut territory at Huluchuan was two hundred li from the border, relying on dangerous distance and making no preparations; Bing sent generals Yao Lin and Peng Sun to strike suddenly; captives and slain numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut territory at Huluchuan was two hundred li from the border, relying on dangerous distance and making no preparations; Bing sent generals Yao Lin and Peng Sun to strike suddenly; captives and slain numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 遷龍圖閣直學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin associate academician of the Longtu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hanlin associate academician of the Longtu Hall.

sentences.zh: 夏酋仁多嵬丁舉國入寇，犯熙河定西城，秉治兵瓦亭，分兩將駐靜邊砦，指夏人來路曰：「吾遲明坐待捷報矣。

translations.literal: The Tangut chieftain Renduowading led the whole state in invasion, attacking Dingxi City in Xihe; Bing arrayed troops at Wating, stationed two generals at Jingbian Fort, and pointed to the Tangut route of advance, saying: "Tomorrow at dawn I shall sit awaiting the report of victory.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut chieftain Renduowading led the whole state in invasion, attacking Dingxi City in Xihe; Bing arrayed troops at Wating, stationed two generals at Jingbian Fort, and pointed to the Tangut route of advance, saying, "Tomorrow at dawn I shall sit awaiting the report of victory."

sentences.zh: 」及明果至，見宋師，驚曰：「天降也。

translations.literal: At dawn they indeed arrived; seeing the Song army, they exclaimed in alarm: "They have fallen from Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: At dawn they indeed arrived; seeing the Song army, they exclaimed in alarm, "They have fallen from Heaven!"

sentences.zh: 」縱擊之，皆奔潰。

translations.literal: They were struck freely and all fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: They were struck freely and all fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 或言嵬丁已死，有識其衣服者，諸將請以聞。

translations.literal: Some said Renduowading was already dead and that there were those who recognized his clothing; the generals asked to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Some said Renduowading was already dead and that there were those who recognized his clothing; the generals asked to report it.

sentences.zh: 秉曰：「幕府上功患不實，吾敢以疑似成欺乎？

translations.literal: Bing said: "The staff office, in reporting merit, fears untruth—how dare I achieve deception on suspicion?
translations.idiomatic: Bing said, "The staff office, in reporting merit, fears untruth—how dare I achieve deception on suspicion?"

sentences.zh: 」他日物色之，嵬丁果死，詔褒賜服馬、金幣，且使上所獲器甲。

translations.literal: Another day they sought him out and Renduowading was indeed dead; an edict praised and rewarded him with robes, horses, and gold and silk, and also ordered him to submit captured armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Another day they sought him out and Renduowading was indeed dead; an edict praised and rewarded him with robes, horses, and gold and silk, and also ordered him to submit captured armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 秉守邊久，表父革年老，乞歸。

translations.literal: Bing long guarded the frontier and memorialized that his father Ge was old and begged to return.
translations.idiomatic: Bing long guarded the frontier and memorialized that his father Ge was old and begged to return.

sentences.zh: 移知湖州，行三驛，復詔還渭，慰藉優渥。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Huzhou; after three post stations an edict again ordered him back to Wei with generous consolation.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Huzhou; after three post stations an edict again ordered him back to Wei with generous consolation.

sentences.zh: 革聞，亦以義止其議。

translations.literal: Ge heard of it and also stopped the request on grounds of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Ge heard of it and also stopped the request on grounds of righteousness.

sentences.zh: 已而革疾亟。

translations.literal: Before long Ge fell gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ge fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 乃得歸。

translations.literal: Only then was Bing permitted to return.
translations.idiomatic: Only then was Bing permitted to return.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，知荊南。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou period he served as prefect of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou period he served as prefect of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 劉安世論其行鹽法虐民，降待制、提舉洞霄宮，卒。

translations.literal: Liu Anshi criticized his enforcement of the salt law as oppressive to the people; he was demoted to attendant, appointed to supervise the Dongxiao Palace, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Anshi criticized his enforcement of the salt law as oppressive to the people; he was demoted to attendant, appointed to supervise the Dongxiao Palace, and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：宋室之人才亦盛矣。

translations.literal: The commentator says: The talent of the Song house was also abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: The talent of the Song house was also abundant.

sentences.zh: 青苗法始行，滿朝耆壽故臣、法家拂士，引古今通誼，盡力爭之而不能止，往往多自引去。

translations.literal: When the Green Sprouts law was first implemented, venerable elders and old ministers throughout the court, legalists and dissenters, citing ancient and modern universal principles, strove with all their strength to oppose it yet could not stop it; many often withdrew of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: When the Green Sprouts law was first implemented, venerable elders and old ministers throughout the court, legalists and dissenters, citing ancient and modern universal principles, strove with all their strength to oppose it yet could not stop it; many often withdrew of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 及數年之後，憲令既成，天下亦莫如之何。

translations.literal: After several years the statutes were established, and throughout the empire none could do anything about it.
translations.idiomatic: After several years the statutes were established, and throughout the empire none could do anything about it.

sentences.zh: 已而間守遠郡，尚能懇懇為民有言。

translations.literal: Yet when guarding distant prefectures, they could still earnestly speak for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when guarding distant prefectures, they could still earnestly speak for the people.

sentences.zh: 舜俞、京、蒙俱以區區一縣令，力抗部使者，視棄其官如弊屣，類非畏威懷祿者能之。

translations.literal: Shunyu, Jing, and Meng all, as mere county magistrates, forcefully resisted circuit envoys, treating the abandonment of office like worn shoes—this is not what those who fear authority and cherish stipends can do.
translations.idiomatic: Shunyu, Jing, and Meng all, as mere county magistrates, forcefully resisted circuit envoys, treating the abandonment of office like worn shoes—this is not what those who fear authority and cherish stipends can do.

sentences.zh: 師孟活饑羸，興水利，擿奸誅惡，所歷可稱；

translations.literal: Shimeng saved the starving and weak, promoted waterworks, exposed wrongdoers and punished evildoers—what he achieved in his posts is worth naming;
translations.idiomatic: Shimeng saved the starving and weak, promoted waterworks, exposed wrongdoers and punished evildoers—what he achieved in his posts is worth naming;

sentences.zh: 逮使契丹，正坐席禮，毅然不少屈。

translations.literal: when serving as envoy to the Khitan, he corrected seating protocol and resolutely would not yield in the least.
translations.idiomatic: when serving as envoy to the Khitan, he corrected seating protocol and resolutely would not yield in the least.

sentences.zh: 時中止林廣縱兵追蠻，深達兵家之變。

translations.literal: Shizhong stopped Lin Guang from releasing troops to pursue the Man and deeply understood the changes of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong stopped Lin Guang from releasing troops to pursue the Man and deeply understood the changes of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 贄居諫省，舉劾無所避，允有直臣之風。

translations.literal: Zhi, while in the Remonstrance Bureau, impeached without avoidance and truly had the bearing of a straight minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi, while in the Remonstrance Bureau, impeached without avoidance and truly had the bearing of a straight minister.

sentences.zh: 建中雅量卻敵，辭嚴氣正，尤為奇偉。

translations.literal: Jianzhong, with elegant magnanimity, repelled the enemy; his words were stern and his spirit upright—especially remarkable.
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong, with elegant magnanimity, repelled the enemy; his words were stern and his spirit upright—especially remarkable.

sentences.zh: 頡雖有才，而深文狡獪，豈其天性然。

translations.literal: Jie, though talented, was deep in legalistic cunning—is this truly his nature?
translations.idiomatic: Jie, though talented, was deep in legalistic cunning—is this truly his nature?

sentences.zh: 革始終廉退，秉不免於阿徇時好，行鹽法以虐民，父子之相遠哉！

translations.literal: Ge from beginning to end was incorrupt and retiring; Bing could not avoid flattering the prevailing fashion, enforcing the salt law to oppress the people—how far father and son differ!
translations.idiomatic: Ge from beginning to end was incorrupt and retiring; Bing could not avoid flattering the prevailing fashion, enforcing the salt law to oppress the people—how far father and son differ!
